    <bpmn:task id="RETRIEVE_SCT_1" name="Retrieve the SCT file" />
    <bpmn:task id="FORWARD_TO_POLICE" name="Forward the SCT warrant possession to Queensland Police" />
    <bpmn:task id="STORE_PHYSICAL_1" name="Store the SCT physical file awaiting report" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="SEND_REQUEST" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="SEND_REQUEST" targetRef="RECEIVE_REQUEST" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="STORE_PHYSICAL_1" targetRef="SEND_REPORT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="SEND_REPORT" targetRef="RECEIVE_REPORT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="RECEIVE_REPORT" targetRef="RETRIEVE_SCT_2" />
